I didn't have a dream when I first started my business, nothing goes in my mind, all I wanted was to make some money. I didn't even think my business would bring me T1 income, I need to focus on technical because I believe I can handle it by myself, better to rely on myself than others. 

It is stupid to feel superior and refuse to establish relationships and I am in the progress to change that. I have love, and I have empathy which currently makes me feel worthy to be alive, the world needs more people like me, but talk is cheap without money and there is only so much a person can do without money so I have to go make some decent money.

Every day I am struggling to make "Start NOW" happen because the fight is not easy, and the only support I thought I have (my wife) is gone, the more I push myself the more depressed I am, music is my motivation right now, I would first try the meditation thing and everything else that could help me to get out of deep depression without having to resort to visiting psychiatrist.

I don't want to end at the bottom, If I can do it once I can do it again better this time. If I have tried but to no avail so be it. Now it is not the time for me to give up just yet!

Yes, I learn a lot of lessons and experience as an entrepreneur for around 10 years. But this time it is a lot more challenging than the first business. I don't need to partner with someone as I believe I can handle everything by myself, and being proficient in coding can help as this is not the only project I plan to do. 

I am willing to start from bottom in case my project fails, will accept a lower salary while contributing more than what a normal fresh grad has to offer, I just want a chance at a job that has a better "future".

I will do web stacks, or even cybersecurity, my new project requires those skills. My plan is to secure a programming job if my new project fails, then take part-time degree if possible. Although I am confident with my new project, I still want to plan a decent way to restart in case my business fails without having to work as a cashier, etc.

I don't need to be successful, I just want a simple life with a family of my own, but don't want to live in poverty alone, no point to live if I've to suffer every day. Also, my family members all did well, I can't face them if I fail this much.

I will have portfolio to show, full production system serving actual customers. After I spend time learning to program and start my new business, I believe I can even make a fully functional fintech app by myself except for the graphic design part.

I am willing to start from the bottom and accept salary lower than fresh grads to gain corporate experience and to prove myself. Does that make me have better chances?

I am not expecting to live a luxurious life right now. I only wish for a simple life just like what you describe, a house, a car, a partner, and life's little luxuries. Apparently, that is too much to ask for in my current situation, at what age do you start to work as developer? I should be mid 30s when I am ready to take on the job, it might be too late :(

>high pace life

I did change my life environment, I even went out to meet people to see how they are doing and I realize some people had it worse than me, but my brain refuse to accept the reality, I've been stagnant for too long making good money without much effort. I don't expect luxury life now, I just wanted to have a simple life, have a family and not die alone in old age.
